info.name: EOTCDev API — Complete Local Test Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the Node/Hono and Python/FastAPI implementations of EOTCDev API. Includes focused daily Gitsawe Bible readings and structured Sinksar annual/monthly feast lists. The default base URL points to the local Python server. Change baseUrl to a Worker URL to run the same requests against TypeScript. All Ethiopian years are Amete Mihret.

exec: pm.test('Successful responses are JSON or calendar data', () => {

request.description: Returns API identity, version, endpoint directory, and examples.

exec: pm.test('API index is valid', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.name).to.eql('EOTCDev API'); pm.expect(b.endpoints).to.be.an('object'); });

request.description: Liveness endpoint. It is excluded from application rate limiting.

exec: pm.test('Service is healthy', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ok'); });

request.description: FastAPI-generated OpenAPI schema. Available on the Python implementation.

exec: pm.test('OpenAPI document is valid', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.openapi).to.match(/^3\./); pm.expect(b.info.title).to.eql('EOTCDev API'); pm.expect(b.paths).to.be.an('object'); });

request.description: Describes today's date in the selected IANA timezone.

exec: pm.test('Today includes both calendars', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.timezone).to.eql(pm.variables.get('timezone')); pm.expect(b.gregorian.date).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/); pm.expect(b.ethiopic.date).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/); });

request.description: Fully describes Gregorian 2026-04-12, Ethiopian Fasika 2018.

exec: pm.test('Fasika date is correct', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.ethiopic.date).to.eql('2018-08-04'); pm.expect(b.weekday.english).to.eql('Sunday'); pm.expect(b.feasts.map(x => x.key)).to.include('fasika'); });

request.description: Accepts an Ethiopian calendar input date.

exec: pm.test('Ethiopian input converts correctly', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.gregorian.date).to.eql('2026-04-12'); });

request.description: Returns JDN, Gregorian, Ethiopian, and weekday representations.

exec: pm.test('Conversion contains JDN', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.jdn).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(b.ethiopic.date).to.eql('2018-08-04'); });

request.description: Converts up to 366 non-contiguous dates. Invalid individual dates are returned as per-item errors.

exec: pm.test('All batch dates converted', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(3); pm.expect(b.results).to.have.length(3); pm.expect(b.results.every(x => x.jdn)).to.be.true; });

request.description: Checks whether a date is fasting and explains the active period and day number.

exec: pm.test('Great Lent is detected', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.isFasting).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.periods[0].key).to.eql('abiy_tsome'); pm.expect(b.periods[0].dayOfPeriod).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Returns the seven canonical fasting periods for an Ethiopian year.

exec: pm.test('Seven fasts returned', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.ethiopicYear).to.eql(2018); pm.expect(b.periods).to.have.length(7); });

request.description: Returns fixed and movable feasts sorted by Gregorian date. Change type to fixed or movable.

exec: pm.test('Feast count matches array', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.type).to.eql('all'); pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.feasts.length); pm.expect(b.feasts.map(x => x.key)).to.include('fasika'); });

request.description: Exposes Amete Alem, evangelist, Medeb, Wenber, Abekte, Metqi, Mebaja Hamer, New Year properties, and every movable feast.
Returns every fully described day in an Ethiopian month.

exec: pm.test('Month has complete day list', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.days).to.eql(30); pm.expect(b.calendar).to.have.length(b.days); });

request.description: Returns the liturgical season, UI theme, boundaries, and day within the season.

exec: pm.test('Season boundaries are present', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.season.key).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.season.theme).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.season.dayOfSeason).to.be.above(0); });

request.description: Converts an Arabic integer to canonical Ge'ez numerals.

exec: pm.test('Ge ez numeral is correct', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.number).to.eql(2018); pm.expect(b.geez).to.eql('፳፻፲፰'); });

request.description: Downloads a deterministic RFC 5545 calendar of fasting periods and feasts.

Focused daily Gitsawe reading list: Psalms, Gospels, Epistles, Acts, and anaphora. It excludes Sinksar and other calendar content. Bible verse text is intentionally omitted from the MIT API because the available editions are CC BY-NC-ND.

exec: pm.test('Daily readings are grouped by service and type', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.services.liturgy.epistles).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(b.services.liturgy.acts).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(b.services.liturgy.gospels).to.have.length.above(0); pm.expect(b.bible.textIncluded).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('sinksar'); });

item.name: Sinksar Annual and Monthly Feast Lists

request.description: Returns the structured annual and monthly feast lists extracted from the Sinksar summary entries. This exact example verifies annual source entry 8-4-4 and monthly source entry 8-4-5.

exec: pm.test('Annual feast summary is extracted from 8-4-4', () => {
pm.test('Monthly feast summary is extracted from 8-4-5', () => {

request.description: Returns fixed-cycle Matins/Liturgy/Vespers appointments, normalized Bible references, and Sinksar titles. Until remaining cycles and precedence are reviewed, resolution is deliberately fixed_candidate_only.

exec: pm.test('Gitsawe sources are linked safely', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.resolution).to.eql('fixed_candidate_only'); pm.expect(b.gitsawe.cycle).to.eql('fixed'); pm.expect(b.sinksar.entryCount).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(b.sinksar.annualFeasts).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(b.sinksar.monthlyFeasts).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(b.sinksar.fullTextAvailable).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.bible.textIncluded).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Demonstrates explicit unresolved precedence on a Sunday movable feast instead of pretending the fixed candidate is final.

exec: pm.test('Precedence conflict is explicit', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(b.resolutionFactors.isSunday).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.resolutionFactors.movableFeasts).to.include('fasika'); pm.expect(b.resolutionFactors.knownPrecedenceConflict).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Expected 400 response for a syntactically plausible date that does not exist.

exec: pm.test('Invalid date is rejected', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); pm.expect(b.error).to.eql('bad_request'); pm.expect(b.message).to.include('not a real Gregorian date'); });

request.description: Expected 400 because Pagumen has five days in Ethiopian year 2018.

exec: pm.test('Invalid Pagumen date is rejected', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(400); pm.expect(b.error).to.eql('bad_request'); pm.expect(b.hint).to.include('Pagumen'); });

request.description: Expected standardized 404 response.

exec: pm.test('Unknown route uses API error contract', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(404); pm.expect(b.error).to.eql('not_found'); pm.expect(b.hint).to.be.a('string'); });
